nodes.title: BeadMaster 6"
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

?It's very easy and quick to make calibrated exact beads in seconds with the new Beadmaster from Rhino Lapidary.

SUPER FAST! This machine creates a perfect sphere from a preform in only 8 seconds!

The machine use 6” diameter, 1/2" thick wheels.

Bead sizes are 4-6-8-10-12 mm

Motor: 0.55 kW monophase 3000rpm

Weight: 70 Lb.

Packed safely in a wooden pallet box

nodes.title: EM-1 Machine
nodes.descriptionHtml:
The Everything machine is FOUR machines in 1. The EM-1 can be used for grinding, sanding, and polishing stones. It has a 6" trim saw for cutting. It features attachments for metalsmiths to create jewelry, and a flexible shaft suitable for both carving and fine metal work. The arbor and motor sits on a waterproofed veneer stand with an accessory drawer.

Additional special features include:

Moveable Sprayers

Undermount Water Filtration System

Adjustable Magnifying Lens & Light

Patented Variable Speed Motor (1 Horsepower Variable Speed with 100% Torque)

Included with purchase:

6" Bonded Diamond Wheel 80 grit

6" Bonded Diamond Wheel 220 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 280 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 600 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 1200 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 3000 grit

Flex Shaft w/ 18pc accessory set and 3pc attachment heads

x2 Silversmithing spindles w/ x3 sanding and polishing wheels

DIALUX Superfinishing paste

DIALUX Polishing paste

Flat Lap w/ 6" magnetic felt pad and 6" magnetic 80 grit disc

Magnifying Glass Attachment

Jointed Light Attachment

x2 Detachable Wrist rests

Water Pump w/ tank filtration system

Splash guards

Moss Filtration Pads

x2 Brass Spray Nozzles

Spoke Wrench

Allen Wrench/Hex key

Crescent Wrench

jsonValue.label: Flexible-shaft packaged set (flexible shaft, 18-piece accessory set and 3 attachment heads)

nodes.title: SawMaster 18"
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

Our SAWMASTER 18’’ Large Cutting machine from Rhino Lapidary is designed for cutting all kinds of materials such as gemstones, marble, ceramics, glass and granite in a fast, safe and standard way in the desired thickness. Thanks to the high technology and durable materials used in our machine, you can cut without any problems for years.

A key feature in this machine are patented longitudinal, anti-vibration, sealed bearings which provide a wiggle-free vice. This makes your cut less prone to breaking and extensive saw-marks, even at a thickness of 1.5mm.

Cutting speed is 8mm/min (1 inch in 3 minutes). In addition, with the Auto-Feed system, patented by Rhino Lapidary, when the saw gets tired or cannot cut for any reason, the vice advancement system automatically slows down and reduces the load of the saw. This extends the life of your saw. It prevents damages such as jamming and breaking caused by user errors. It also protects the motor by slowing down the cutting when necessary and prevents it from heating and burning.

In addition, the machine has an automatic stop feature in place for when the cutting is finished or if the cover is opened while it is working. All parts are CE and TSEK certified.

Fits up to 18" Saw

Blade not included

Electricity: 110V 60HZ

Cutting Height: 6 1/2"

Cutting Length: 9 7/8"

Cutting Speed: 7/8’’/min

Motor: 1.8KW 1700rpm with crossfeed

Machine Dimensions: 105cm width x 130cm length x 130cm height

Machine Weight: 287lbs

Blade not included

All parts are CE and TSEK certified

nodes.alt: Rhino Lapidary SawMaster machine with the lid open, angled view

nodes.title: ShapeMaster 6"
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

With the new SHAPEMASTER from Rhino Lapidary, it's very easy and quick to make calibrated, exact shapes, even with little to no experience. Shaping a heart, oval, round, barrel, marquise, and many more are all possible just by gently turning the control wheel. You can also make shapes in larger or smaller sizes without changing the master shape.

29 trendy metal master shapes come included with the machine free.

The machine uses 6” diameter 1/2" wheels for 3D shapes and 1/4" wheels for cabs.

Electricity: 110V 60Hz

Motor: 0.55 kW monophase 3000 rpm

Cooling: circulating tap water

Wheels: 6” diameter, 1” hole diameter

1/2 R: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 mm

1/4 R: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 mm

Dimensions: 20” x 24” x 16”

Weight: 100 Lb.

Packed safely in a wooden pallet box

nodes.title: TrimMaster
nodes.descriptionHtml:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb

?Sawing slabs and stones for years in comfort is possible with the new TRIMMASTER trim saw!

You will never have a rusted cutting platform of your machine again, thanks to the Plexiglass surface that easily lifts away. The plexiglass has 4 drainage holes to keep water/oil in the lower reservoir, and adjustable feet let you ensure the tilt is correct for the drainage, even if you are not on a perfectly level surface.

The Trimmaster also comes with spacers for the plexiglass cover that allow you to raise it over the edge of the cutting platform for cutting larger material. There is also a removable, straight-edge guide included for consistent and accurate cutting.

Electricity: 110V 60Hz

Motor: Monophase, 0.37 kw, >3000 rpm

Cooling: self circulating water/oil

Cutting Length: 5"

Cutting Height: 2"

Dimensions: W14” x L22” x H14”

Weight: 50 Lb.

Packed safely in a wooden pallet box

Blade not included

compatible with 6” or 8” diameter, 1” hole diameter
